last_edition.label: 9th edition (2026), returned after a year off

attendance.note: 80 surfers competed in the 9th edition in 2026 (Donostia San Sebastian Turismoa, Google snippet); the 2018 5th edition drew close to 100 competitors. Spectator numbers not published.

notes: The organiser is the Hawaii surf shop in Donostia, with Oxbow as 2026 co-naming partner (RVCA in 2017 and 2018) and the city tourism board as a 2026 sponsor. The pack's @singlefinclassic account is empty and unrelated; the active account is the organiser's @hawaiidonostia.
